summary: Example NETCONF task backs up the Junos config with junos_config backup: yes.
questions: How do I back up a Junos config?

answer_card.title: Back up Junos config
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Backup current switch config (junos)
  junipernetworks.junos.junos_config:
    backup: yes
  register: backup_junos_location
  when: ansible_network_os == 'junipernetworks.junos.junos'
```
